issues.problem: Content scripts can read the stored token by default, the options page loads it into the editable field, and a server response controls an unvalidated URL path segment.
issues.fix: Restrict token storage to trusted contexts before access, show only the last four characters of a saved token, add Remove and format validation, and validate both incoming messages and the event ID before fetching. Add isolated-world access and network allowlist tests.

issues.problem: Board presence qualifies pages for help, including active lichess rounds and other excluded contexts. An open panel can continue to display an earlier answer after navigation.
issues.fix: Require positive page-scope evidence on initial load, navigation, and ask. Abort in-flight requests and clear answers when the new page is out of scope. Test direct entry and open-panel navigation with zero requests.

issues.problem: A click can send an earlier position, and a site FEN can disagree with the displayed board without warning. Replies are displayed without a position check.
issues.fix: Re-read and compare the position before posting, bind the request to the click-time snapshot, reconcile exact FEN and move lists with the visible board, and validate the returned position against that snapshot. Cover step-back and inconsistent-FEN cases with full outbound assertions.

issues.problem: Malformed answers can strand the panel in a frozen thinking state. The client has no connect, idle, or overall deadline and retries non-transient failures.
issues.fix: Validate both response shapes before sending results to the panel. Return typed failures, enforce the 20-, 45-, and 150-second deadlines, and restrict backup to transient codes. Add real-extension survival, timeout, malformed-reply, and observed-abort cases.

issues.problem: The truncated recording shows a disagreement based on an unverified prose move and gives it the wrong side label.
issues.fix: Separate verified SAN from suggestions. Verify prose with the legality-checked UCI and returned FEN before allowing a verdict. Assert the exact truncated card and cover every source and finish value.

issues.problem: A required wildcard and absent privacy policy block submission. There is no package or store handoff.
issues.fix: Require only the two built-in host grants and request optional custom access for the exact chosen origin. Add the policy, allowlist package script and extracted-zip smoke test, synchronized release metadata, licensed attribution, and the listing and owner artifacts.

issues.problem: Permissive SAN cleanup, unconditional standard roots, and broad board selectors admit unreliable position inputs.
issues.fix: Validate SAN without deleting semantic characters, parse known custom roots, preserve six-field exact FENs, and reject transient or impossible board scans. Expand both fixture matrices to assert identity, UI, and full requests or zero requests as appropriate.

issues.problem: Concurrent tabs can start independent jobs, Ask again reuses the same seed, and users cannot configure a custom Space.
issues.fix: Add profile-wide request coordination and spacing, a bounded session cache and fresh re-ask seed, exact-origin custom configuration with separate token consent, and answering-server attribution.

issues.problem: The panel misses close-focus restoration, key isolation, and live announcements. Several controls have small targets or weak contrast.
issues.fix: Implement the specified focus order and focus-scoped Escape, isolate panel keys, add live regions and non-color cues, and adjust target and contrast styles. Verify with keyboard-only and shadow-root axe tests with a planted positive control.

issues.problem: The panel has no first-use disclosure, no stale-result flag, and incomplete waiting, result, and error state evidence.
issues.fix: Add the first-use and stale states, follow the required result order and error copy, and capture every specified state. Verify board and navigation clearance at both viewports or add remembered one-action docking.

issues.problem: Open-panel position updates rely on 1.5-second polling, and the elapsed timer can update while the tab is hidden.
issues.fix: Use a scoped debounced observer for open-panel changes, suspend hidden-tab UI work, and test timing plus host, listener, and timer stability after ten SPA navigations.

issues.problem: The round's green tests omit several required paths and cannot prove which shared-URL fixture served a request. The README omits test and package instructions.
issues.fix: Assert a unique served-fixture identity before requests, fill the screenshot and test matrix gaps, add mutation checks, and document the test command, package command, fair-play rules, privacy, and recovery paths.

issues.problem: The owner reported a successful live chess.com read in chat, but the required sign-off artifact is absent.
issues.fix: Have the owner record the dated 8...b5 check with the expected position and extension version in docs/live-checklist.md.
